{{Quote|This once belonged to an old friend of mine. And now it is yours, as reward for your impressive training.|Count Dooku to General Grievous|<ref name="teor" />}}
This [[Color/Legends|blue]]-[[Plasma/Legends|bladed]] '''lightsaber''' was a [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] that had once belonged to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]]. It contained a blue [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]]. After the Jedi Master's [[Death/Legends|death]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], it was given to the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] for him to use. It served as the first [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] for his collection.

==History==
===Sith Trophy===
[[File:Sifodyas.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The lightsaber with its former owner's corpse.]]

This [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was created by [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] during his [[Standard year/Legends|years]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. He additionally owned [[Sifo-Dyas's lightsaber/Legends|another lightsaber]], which was on his person at the time of his [[Death/Legends|death]] on the [[Oba Diah moon/Legends|desert moon of Oba Diah]]. Following his death, Dooku collected the saber not on his person as well as Dyas' corpse, which were preserved in a coffin-like transparent freezer unit, the body arranged as if resting with the lightsaber still clasped in his hands.<ref name="teor" />

Dooku kept hold of the lightsaber during the [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] reconstruction and training of the mortally wounded [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Grievous/Legends|Qymaen jai Sheelal]], eventually presenting it the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] as a reward. However, when Dooku did so, he referred to Sheelal as a "[[Droid/Legends|droid]]," enraging the Kaleesh.<ref name="teor" />

===Usage by the Jedi Hunter===
Shortly after Dooku left, Sheelal began deteriorating into violent rage. Sitting in his chair trembling, Sheelal finally leapt into the air and attacked his own [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]. Wielding the lightsaber against them, Sheelal executed them with brutal speed and efficiency. When he finished, Sheelal angrily stated that he wasn't a droid, and declared himself [[General/Legends|General]] Grievous.<ref name="teor" />

[[File:GvMGVisionaries.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Grievous wielding the lightsaber against his own MagnaGuards in a fit of rage.]]
Throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Grievous would add the lightsabers of the Jedi he killed to the collection which started with the former blade of Sifo-Dyas.<ref name="teor" />
